\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage[dvipsnames]{xcolor}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18,
  colormap={rgbfirst}{color(0cm)=(blue);color(1cm)=(yellow)},
  colormap={cmykfirst}{color(0cm)=(cyan);color(1cm)=(black)},
  colormap={dvipsrgb}{color(0cm)=(blue);color(1cm)=(SkyBlue);color(2cm)=(SpringGreen);color(3cm)=(yellow)}
}
\begin{document}
\foreach \name in {rgbfirst,cmykfirst,dvipsrgb}{
  \typeout{COLORMAP \name: \pgfplotscolormapcolorspaceof{\name}}
  \foreach \value in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}{
    \pgfplotscolormapfind[0:1]{\value}{\name}
    \typeout{SAMPLE \name\space \value: \pgfmathresult}
  }
}
\definecolor{midcmyk}{cmyk}{.5,0,0,.5}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\fill[midcmyk] (0,0) rectangle (1,1);
\fill[SkyBlue] (1,0) rectangle (2,1);
\fill[SpringGreen] (2,0) rectangle (3,1);
\fill[orange!75!red] (3,0) rectangle (4,1);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
